lots.lot_title: Provision of Lift Services (Draft T&Cs - Lot 7 of procurement 6278)
lots.description: Three-year services contract for the provision of lift services by The Mayor and Burgesses of the London Borough of Bexley. The document seen here is the draft Form of Contract, General Terms and Conditions (Part 2) and Special Conditions (Part 3) for Lot 7 of the wider 6278 procurement; the substantive scope (Schedule 1 Specification), pricing structure (Schedule 2 Pricing Schedule / Appendix 1 PPM Schedule) and evaluation criteria / KPIs (Appendix C to the Invitation to Tender, Schedule 3) are referenced throughout but are NOT included in this markdown (they appear as heading-only placeholders at the end of the document, lines 1222-1228). Price structure referenced in the draft T&Cs: Annual Fee Services (PPM / Planned Preventative Maintenance) plus Works Orders that fall outside the Annual Fee. The document is described as LIFT SERVICES in the Form of Contract title block (line 17) but Recital A (line 37) contains stale template wording 'security services' that was not updated when the template was repurposed.

requirements: Contract commences on the Commencement Date (1 September 2020) and expires on 31 August 2023 unless terminated earlier or extended under Clause F8 (Recital A, Clause A2, Clause 1.3).

The Contractor must supply the Services during the Contract Period in accordance with the Council's requirements set out in the Specification (Schedule 1) and the provisions of the Contract, in consideration of the Contract Price (Clause B1.1).
Timely supply of the Services is of the essence of the Contract (Clause B1.3).

The Contractor must provide all Equipment necessary for supply of the Services at its own risk, maintain it in a safe, serviceable and clean condition, and remove it on completion (Clauses B2.1-B2.6, S9.1-S9.3).

The Contractor must comply with Quality Standards (BSI British Standards, ISO or other reputable equivalent), with Good Industry Practice, and (where applicable) maintain accreditation with the relevant Quality Standards authorisation body (Clause B3.1, A1 'Quality Standards' definition).
Contractor's Staff must be competent, skilled, honest and experienced, in full uniform or appropriate safety clothing, and satisfactory DBS checks are required (Clauses B4.1-B4.11).
The Contractor must appoint a Contract Manager and sufficient supervisory employees; Key Personnel designated in the Specification/Tender are subject to Clause B5.

The Contractor must service the Council's Plant and maintain it in good working order in accordance with manufacturer's guarantees/recommendations (Clause S2.4) - this is the core obligation for the lift services (Plant means the Council's lift plant).
The Contractor must perform the functions of 'principal designer' and 'principal contractor' under the CDM Regulations 2015 to the extent applicable (Clause S2.3).

All materials/goods supplied as part of the Services must be as specified in the Specification; where not specified they must be of the best available quality and comply with the latest applicable British Standard (Clause S5.1).
Warranty benefits on supplied materials/goods must extend to the Council (Clause S5.2).

Materials must not be known-deleterious, must not contravene any relevant BSI / European standard, and must comply with 'Good Practice in Selection of Construction Materials' (BCO) - Clauses S2.6.1 - S2.6.3.

The Contractor must comply with all Data Protection Legislation (GDPR, DPA 2018, LED), protect Council Data, maintain appropriate Protective Measures and secure systems, and cooperate with FOIA/EIR requests (Clauses E1, E1A, E4).
The Contractor must comply with the Bribery Act 2010 and must not commit any Prohibited Act (Clauses A1 'Prohibited Act', D1).

The Contractor must comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and applicable HSC/HSE codes of practice, and provide its health and safety policy statement on request (Clauses D6, S2.2.2, S3.5).

The Contractor must maintain a COSHH register for substances stored at or brought onto the Premises, keep it up to date, hold a copy at the Premises and provide copies to the Council (Clauses S3.4.1 - S3.4.3).
The Contractor must assess TUPE applicability at its own risk; no price variation after contract signature on TUPE grounds; indemnity in favour of the Council (Clauses S1.1 - S1.7).
The Council may transfer or sub-contract, and imposes restrictions on the Contractor's ability to sub-contract - Sub-Contractors may be named in the Specification (Clauses F1, S7.1 - S7.4).

Insurance: the Council may require higher insurance limits than those in Clause G1.7 where the specific requirements of the Contract so demand (Clauses G1.2, G1.7, G1.10 - G1.11); the actual minimum insurance values must be read from the Specification / Special Conditions and are not present in this markdown.
Professional Indemnity insurance where applicable (Clause G2).
Works not forming part of the Annual Fee Services (ad-hoc remedial or project works) are instructed as Works Orders outside the Annual Fee (A1 'Works Order' definition, line 392).

Annual Fee Services = the Planned Maintenance / PPM Schedule supplied under Appendix 1 to the Invitation to Tender (A1 'Annual Fee Services' definition, line 215) - the PPM schedule content itself is not in this markdown.

Dispute resolution: Scheme for Construction Contracts adjudication with Chartered Institute of Building nominee, then CIMAR arbitration (Clauses S10.1 - S10.6); governing law is England & Wales with courts jurisdiction (I1, I2).
Management Reports per Clauses F7.1/F7.2 including reporting on KPIs in the format agreed with the Council.
Termination rights: default (H2), insolvency and change of control (H1), further grounds (H2A), break (H3).

warnings.summary: Schedule 1 Specification is referenced throughout the draft T&Cs but is only a heading placeholder in this markdown (line 1222). The substantive service scope, lift asset inventory, visit frequencies, response SLAs and lift-specific engineering standards therefore cannot be extracted from this document. Downstream extraction of the Specification document is required before product_candidates can be populated with confidence.

Schedule 2 Pricing Schedule is only a heading placeholder (line 1224). The Annual Fee figure ('£ [insert figure]' at line 213) is a template placeholder. No per-lift rates, Works Order day rates or materials markups are present.

KPIs and Service Credits are referenced as defined in Appendix C to the Invitation to Tender (Schedule 3), but Schedule 3 is only a heading placeholder (line 1226). No KPI definitions, thresholds, scoring methodology or Service Credit amounts are available. evaluation_criteria therefore cannot be returned with weightings for this lot.

Recital A (line 37) contains stale template wording 'security services' even though the title block (line 17) and document title record 'LIFT SERVICES'. This is a template repurposing error in the source document, not an ambiguity in this lot's scope.

No lift-specific engineering standards (BS EN 81 series, BS EN 13015, BS 7255, LOLER 1998, PUWER 1998) are cited in the visible markdown. Only generic BSI/ISO/British Standard references appear. Lift-specific standards are expected to live in Schedule 1 Specification, which is not included.

No CPV codes are cited in the visible markdown. This is a draft T&Cs document rather than a notice; CPV codes would normally be found in the Contract Notice or the Invitation to Tender front matter. Extraction returns an empty cpv_codes array rather than guessing (the plausible CPV 50750000-7 'Lift-maintenance services' was NOT emitted because it is not supported by an evidence anchor in this document).
Clause G1.10 states that minimum insurance cover will be specified in the Specification or Special Conditions, but no numeric minimum insurance limits are present in this markdown.
The Annual Fee definition contains the placeholder '£ [insert figure]' (line 213). The actual Annual Fee would be entered post-award on execution.

Lot number 7 is derived from the document title '6278 - Draft T&Cs - Lot 7' (document_extraction.document_title) rather than from a 'Lot 7' heading inside the markdown itself. The markdown contains no 'Lot 7' label. Other lots of procurement 6278 are not in scope of this extraction.
